messages:
anya: quick design check — i'm worried the suppression preview feels ambiguous for multi-channel rules. can we make the preview announce who will actually be suppressed?

samir: yeah looks confusing. current preview says 'notifications suppressed' but doesn't list the channels or routing. users expect to see exact mapping.

maria: agree. also accessibility: if the preview changes after you toggle a channel, screen readers should announce the new recipients. maybe use aria-live on the preview pane.

tom: related: when a rule falls back to the secondary channel (sms -> email), preview should show the fallback path. users were surprised in the last demo.

anya: proposal: show a compact list with explicit rows: channel badge + status + reason. e.g.
```
#oncall  · suppressed  · matches: business-hours
#pager  · delivered   · fallback from sms
```
This keeps compactness but explicit.

samir: +1. for keyboard users the rows need focusable actions (edit/remove). for a11y, add an aria-label like 'suppression preview: 2 channels, 1 fallback'.

maria: tiny copy tweak: replace 'suppressed' with 'silenced' in the UI? 'Suppressed' reads technical. 'Silenced' is friendlier. thoughts?

tom: i'm neutral but prefer consistent terminology across alerts and incidents. if we change copy, update helptext and API docs.

anya: good call. we should run a quick microcopy check. maybe: 'Silenced (during business hours)'. keeps context.

samir: implementation note: the preview currently builds from route.id only. we'll need to resolve route variants to human-friendly names at render time — small change but hits caching. flagging perf.

design-bot: uploaded a prototype screenshot: https://redwood-internal/screenshots/1741112222/preview-v3.png :eyes:

maria: I like the visual hierarchy. but contrast on the 'silenced' pill is low at 12px. accessibility fail. bump contrast and increase size to 13px.

anya: action items — @samir investigate route-resolve perf impact; @maria update pill contrast & microcopy; @tom run a docs pass for terminology; i'll mock updated preview with aria-live region and post before EOD.

samir: on it. i'll post a short perf note in the thread once i have numbers.

maria: adding a small acceptance criteria: NVDA reads 'suppression preview: oncall silenced, pager delivered' when toggling.

tom: sounds good. if no objections i'll close this after the mock. :thumbsup:

anya: no objections, thanks everyone! :sparkles:
